description: Computer engineering student at Politecnico di Milano, building iOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI. Projects, writing and background of Samuele Segrini.
ticker: Swift & SwiftUI · iOS · Politecnico di Milano · Distributed systems ·

home.title: Samuele Segrini — Software Engineer
home.headline: iOS developer,
home.intro: I'm finishing a computer engineering degree at Politecnico di Milano. On my own I built an iOS management app for a restaurant — counter, floor and kitchen, down to the fiscal printer — and distributed systems in Java alongside other people.
home.workText: An iOS app used at the counter, a distributed game in Java, a micromobility service designed with its users: for each one, the decisions behind it.
home.writingText: Notes on what I actually had to understand: architectures, data synchronisation, platform constraints.
home.pathText: Six years in order of appearance: the accounting data, the degree, the first real client, code that has to hold over a network, and the people who will use it.

milestones.label: First internships
milestones.text: SQL over accounting data in PROFIS, then front-end and back-end work on client web applications. The first time the code I wrote had to be useful to someone.

milestones.label: Engineering
milestones.text: After a business IT diploma, 100/100. Algorithms, networks and architectures: the foundations underneath everything else.

milestones.label: EasyManager
milestones.text: An iOS management app built on my own in Swift and SwiftUI: MVVM, Firebase for users, roles and realtime orders, counter, floor and kitchen down to the fiscal printer over HTTP/XML.

milestones.label: Galaxy Trucker
milestones.text: A distributed multiplayer game in Java: authoritative server, JavaFX and TUI clients, TCP sockets and RMI, and a game state that has to stay consistent across clients.

milestones.label: SpinGO
milestones.text: A micromobility ecosystem designed with people: user research, low- to high-fidelity prototypes, heuristic evaluation and usability testing.

home.contactText: Looking for a first role in iOS development. Reply within 24 hours, Italian time zone.
